title: The resource lifecycle: replace, ignore_changes and depends_on

videos.script: Ana changes one line in a Terraform file. Sometimes Terraform edits the resource where it stands. Sometimes it destroys the resource and builds a new one in its place. {{plan}} The plan says which, with a symbol and a short comment beside the line. Reading that comment is the first thing this lesson teaches. {{replace}} A replacement has an order. By default the old one goes first, and for a moment nothing exists. You can turn the order around, and then a fixed name gets in the way. {{order}} Then come the controls. One refuses to destroy the shop's bucket. One leaves a tag to the finance team's tool. One asks for a new machine when none of its own arguments changed. {{lifecycle}} After that, the edges Terraform cannot see. A boot script that reads a bucket by name depends on it, and the graph has no arrow for that. {{graph}} Last, how to stop managing something without deleting it. {{removed}}
